name: harness
description: Opus plans, Haiku scouts, Sonnet builds, Opus tries to break it, Fable signs off. Role-based subagents, ship/review/audit workflows, and optional gates from other model families.

decision_gate.title: Decision gate
decision_gate.description: Cheap 'is this really done?' check when a turn that changed files ends. 'auto' runs when a backend is configured (a Jev or OpenAI key, a local decision server, or the provider below); 'off' never runs it.

decision_provider.title: Decision provider
decision_provider.description: Which backend answers the gate. 'auto' uses a paid key if one is set, then a local server if its URL is set. Free choices: 'local' (llama.cpp, Ollama or Cloudflare Clef running an open decision model), 'claude-cli' (Haiku through your Claude Code login, draws on plan usage, about 3 s), 'heuristic' (rules, no model).

local_decision_url.title: Local decision server URL (optional)
local_decision_url.description: Base URL of a server that speaks the System One API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 for llama-server or http://127.0.0.1:11434 for Ollama. Setting it is enough for 'auto' to use it.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Enables the GPT second-opinion reviewer and, if no Jev key is set, the OpenAI Decisions gate. Leave empty to use the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable or skip OpenAI entirely.

openai_judge_model.title: OpenAI reviewer model
openai_judge_model.description: Model the GPT second-opinion reviewer uses. gpt-6-sol is the cost-efficient high-end tier; gpt-6-astra is the flagship at 5x the price.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe (Jev) API key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: Enables the Jev decision gate. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment, or to skip Jev.
